Golf cart!

6 Bikes!

6 bedrooms, 5 full baths, 2 half baths

Cozy living room fireplace

Gas grill

Main house + Carriage house

Pelican and Palm by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Pelican and Palm is easy coastal living with just the right amount of polish. Tucked along a quiet, tree-shaded street, this charming two-story home welcomes you with a welcoming front porch, made for slow coffees, sunset cocktails, and doing absolutely nothing on purpose. When it’s time to play, you’re just minutes from WaterColor’s amazing resort-style pools, a palm-lined deck, and that perfect stretch of white sand and turquoise water. Hop on one of six bikes! Inside, light-filled spaces feel relaxed and put-together, warm wood floors, coastal-blue accents, plush seating, and a cozy fireplace for low-key nights in. The bright, modern kitchen (white cabinetry, stainless appliances, quartz/marble counters, garden windows) is made for real beach meals, whether you’re gathering at the island or lingering around the dining table. Bedrooms are calm, comfortable, and beautifully layered with crisp linens, soft textures, and leafy views. Bathrooms keep things spa-like with marble vanities, glass showers, and a soaking tub that earns its keep after a long beach day.

A sunny upstairs hallway, cheerful laundry room, and cozy writing nook add thoughtful, livable touches throughout. Pelican and Palm is the kind of place that feels like home, if your home just happens to be in WaterColor. Oversee 30A: clean, comfy stays with a local team nearby, seven days a week. Enjoy your stay! Overview: - 1.3 miles to the beach (Beach Club private access) - 1.7 miles to Seaside - Access to five WaterColor resort-style pools - 6 bedrooms, 5 full baths, 2 half baths - Complimentary golf cart - 6 complimentary bikes - Separate carriage house with kitchenette - Two laundry rooms (main & carriage) - Two dishwashers - Living room fireplace - Gas grill - Wi-Fi *One parking spot available at the home and an overflow parking spot throughout neighborhood. * This home is being renovated, renovations will be complete at the beginning of April. Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed w/ private bath - Half Bathroom SECOND FLOOR - Guest Room: King bed, private bathroom - Guest Room: King bed, private bathroom - Guest Room: King bed, private bathroom - Bunkroom: twin/twin bunks, attached half bathroom CARRIAGE HOUSE - Guest Room: King bed, private bathroom Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
